info.name: True_connector_DSP
info.description:
TRUE Connector DSP Postman Collection

Default tenant: engineering
Consumer: http://localhost:8080
Provider: http://localhost:8090

Users (BASIC auth mode):
  superadmin@mail.com / password  - ROLE_SUPER_ADMIN (manages tenants)
  admin@mail.com / password       - ROLE_ADMIN, tenantId=engineering
  connector@mail.com / password   - ROLE_CONNECTOR, tenantId=engineering

Protocol endpoints include tenantId path segment: /{tenantId}/catalog, /{tenantId}/negotiations, /{tenantId}/transfers
Use TENANT_ID env variable for the active tenant.

item.description:
Keycloak token management requests matching the realm configuration.

Password Grant Requests (for users):
- Admin User (admin@test.com)
- Normal User (user@test.com)
- Connector User (connector@test.com)

Client Credentials Requests (for services):
- Provider Backend Service
- Consumer Backend Service

All requests automatically store tokens in both collection and environment variables.

item.description:
Management API (Basic Auth).

Default tenant: engineering
Admin user: admin@mail.com / password (ROLE_ADMIN, tenantId=engineering)
Super-admin: superadmin@mail.com / password (ROLE_SUPER_ADMIN, no tenant)
Connector user: connector@mail.com / password (ROLE_CONNECTOR, tenantId=engineering)

For tenant management (Tenant folder), requests use superadmin@mail.com.
